name: RulerMC » SMP & Practice [1.8 - 26.3]
description:
🌍 SMP

A fresh survival world built for long-term play:

• Teams: build a crew and fight for the top

• Skills, levels & daily quests to grow your character

• Player shop, auction house & jobs economy

• Custom enchantments, spawners & crates

• KOTH events, custom bosses and an AFK zone for rewards

🗡 Practice PvP

Sharpen your skills:

• Duels, FFA and kit-based fights

• Leaderboards and stats to track your progress

• Smooth combat with a strong anti-cheat

✨ Network Features

• Proximity voice chat (Simple Voice Chat mod)

• Custom ranks, tags & cosmetics

• Vote daily for crate keys and rewards

• Network-wide events, currently 🎃 Halloween Treats!

• Active staff and a friendly community
